rationale: FX02 flagged fair_value_currency value U_USD as not USD. The raw Schedule of Investments Fair Value column is dollar-denominated, with an explicit dollar marker in the Fair Value header/column and representative USD par row fair value shown as $ 280,864. Foreign-par rows show the fair value as a dollar amount with only a parenthetical local-currency equivalent, e.g. 58,027 (EUR 51,994) and 83,063 (EUR 74,426). Thus U_USD is the USD unit token and the check, not the extracted fair_value_currency, is wrong.
